shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && ls -a && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; f=$(grep -rl "^title: cookies" 01-app | head -1); echo $f; sed -n 1,80p "$f"; f2=$(grep -rl "^title: headers" 01-app | head -1); echo $f2; sed -n 1,60p "$f2"

cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15 && (npx next start -p 3456 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s localhost:3456 | grep -o 'Current theme.*' ; curl -s -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8' localhost:3456 | grep -oE 'data-testid="(theme|language)">[^<]*'; pkill -f "next start"
